title: Restless Orbit
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Your laughter lingers in the hallway
We chased the daylight down the coast

[Chorus]
And every road keeps calling out my name
Whisper secrets to the open sky

[Verse 2]
We chased the daylight down the coast
Your laughter lingers in the hallway

[Chorus]
And every road keeps calling out my name
Whisper secrets to the open sky

[Outro]
The night is ours to keep
structure: Intro (4 bars) / Verse (16) / Chorus (16) / Verse (16) / Chorus (16) / Bridge (8) / Chorus (16) / Outro (4)
desc: A smooth hip-hop song at 75 BPM in A# major, written by the Signature song engine.
